crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.
The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.
He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.
For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.
There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”
All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his…
For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
“This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.
The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell—and great was its fall.”
He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.
There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man swallows it up.
If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness…
His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

translations.web: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
translations.bsb: The house of the wicked will be destroyed, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
translations.kjv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
translations.asv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.
